[b]The National Militias Act[/b]

War is a fickle thing that degrades a nations pride and image if a nation begins to perceive it is on the losing end of the war. Rosenmarkke was not losing the war, not functionally anywayssure the navy was potentially inoperable, and hell was about to break loose on the islandsbut Rosenmarkke was still winning.

However because Rosenmarkke had noted the involvement of the EDU extensively into the affairs of the war, it only felt right for Rosenmarkke to call upon a shadier source of support.

Under the National Militia Act the government would be permitted to redesignate foreign militias and PMCs for hire as national security agents, making them a part of Rosenmarkke, thereby allowing Rosenmarkke to avoid the embarrassment of relying on foreign troops to help its efforts, as a result the Council of 99, would authorize its usage to permit the noted Vespurian company SummitOne to operate within Rosenmarkke as a PMC of Rosenmarkke under the command of some sarjant. Of course the command was fake but the public, the press, and the propagandists wouldnt know the difference.
